paper_metadata.title: Interdiffusivities and atomic mobility parameters of fcc Ni-Mo-Nb alloys: experimental diffusion couple studies and numerical inverse method
paper_metadata.journal: Journal of Materials Research and Technology

evidence.quote: This investigation combines experimental diffusion couple studies with a numerical inverse method incorporated in CALTPP software to evaluate interdiffusivities and atomic mobility parameters for fcc Ni – Mo – Nb alloys.
The composition profiles of the fcc Ni – Mo – Nb alloys at three temperatures (1273 – 1473 K) were determined experimentally.
